title: κ = 1.018419742888184e-3: combined exact gate-frame retimings
body:
κ = 1.018419742888184e-3

Starting from the fully replayed #423 word, this construction composes eleven individually verified frame retimings with the two joint block retimings from #427. All scalar instructions, scalar order and 217-gauge/391-dimensional entrance spaces remain fixed. The constructor checks all 1,021 raw and pre-snapshot columns, retained labels and the exact unchanged scalar word. The combined local profile is priced from the actual final word.

The complete verifier exits 0 after rebuilding both scalar orientations, arbitrary dirty restoration, private erasure, both reflected scalar/frame ledgers, 1,022 new/reflected Gaussian phase pairs, 55 residual frames and 28,160 address columns. The native controls reject all 50 changed frame labels, 20 original-A frame reversions and an omitted entrance gate. The actual 6,996 nongauged dirty-response entries expand into 7,097 signed unit macros; 16 literal coefficient-word microchecks pass.

The architecture is rebuilt from that final word: 2,580,849 paid children, rank mass 8,313,201, 49,984 owner routes, 5,857 banks per stage, 114,153 live stock, 114,944 physical stock and 19,968 deficit. The fresh scalar invoice contains 66,178,176 real primitives and 249,984 explicit bank-boundary adapters. Independent readback recomputes the full profile, routes, finite invoice, reserve bridge and all 47 strict outer inequalities. The exact complex coarse lower is `127302467861023/125000000000000000000000`; the unchanged bit lower is `255384852701747/250000000000000000`.

```sh
python -B research/e8-combined-retiming217/verify.py /absolute/path/to/new/output
```

The development replay, independent local/global audits and clean committed archive replay all exited 0. Every committed package blob is checked against its manifest. Python 3.11+ and C++17 are required. The default replay reuses source-bound evidence for the unchanged bit component and prior phase edges; optional `--replay-bit` freshly repeats the bundled bit component.

This is a finite conditional construction. Inherited all-size compressed-window, arbitrary-correlated dirty-bank, recursive compiler, ordinary-call/fixed-tape/restored-row, common-grid, precision and analytic interfaces remain assumptions. Quarter/eighth coefficients are explicit paid primitives. No unchanged legacy gx/gxcore E4/E5 acceptance, Lean certificate, global optimality or unconditional multiplication theorem is claimed.

Concurrent #424, #425 and #426 report numerically higher claims with different construction interfaces and their own stated scope. This PR records a fully replayed successor of #423/#427; it does not claim the highest numerical report. Provenance and contributor notices are preserved. The combined frame search, source-pinned construction, integration and audits were prepared for **eumemic with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**.
